notes.title: Small Update 7/17/2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a cutscene to the beginning of E1M2 to help with some lore context.
[/list]

Right now we're working on a rework of the meat furnace and some substantial changes to E1M4 and E1M5 to make them a lot more fun + the secret level for episode 1. Hopefully the E1M4 & 5 changes will be ready soon and we can share them with y'all.

notes.title: Small Update 6/22/25
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a truck headlight missing collision on E1M2
[*] Adjusted destructibles to be more open minded about getting out of the way
[*] A bunch of sfx/audio tuning
[*] New rocket launcher alt fire (it's a salvo)
[*] Boosted rocket launcher force on player
[*] Possibly/maybe and I [i]cannot[/i] stress this enough potentially addressed some of the shader problems across various graphics cards. We don't have a way to test a lot of these so it's shooting in the dark (much like you do in the game)
[/list]
